name: app.R
content:
# app.R
# seaurchin: a Shinylive (WebAssembly) companion to the Andalividus Bayesian
# dose-response study. Loads precomputed posterior parameter draws from
# data/*.csv.gz and re-evaluates the 4PL formula client-side for every user
# input. Bilingual (English default, Spanish toggle). No server, no Stan,
# no brms at runtime.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(shiny)
    library(bslib)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(scales)
    library(DT)
    library(htmltools)
    library(plotly)
    library(leaflet)
    library(base64enc)
})

# Shiny 1.5+ auto-sources R/*.R when app.R is present, but be explicit so the
# script also runs from a non-package launcher.
local({
    r_files <- list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)
    for (f in r_files) source(f, local = FALSE)
})

# ============================ #
# 1. data layer (loaded once) ####
# ============================ #

params_fert   <- load_params_draws("fert")
params_larva  <- load_params_draws("larva")
pred_fert     <- load_pred_grid("fert")
pred_larva    <- load_pred_grid("larva")
ecx_fert      <- load_ecx_draws("fert")
ecx_larva     <- load_ecx_draws("larva")
psr_fert      <- load_psr_draws("fert")
psr_larva     <- load_psr_draws("larva")

ecx_summary   <- read_csv_plain(file.path("data", "ecx_summary.csv"))
psr_summary   <- read_csv_plain(file.path("data", "psr_summary.csv"))
raw_long      <- read_csv_plain(file.path("data", "raw_long.csv"))
site_meta     <- read_csv_plain(file.path("data", "site_meta.csv"))
sunscreen_meta<- read_csv_plain(file.path("data", "sunscreen_meta.csv"))

# Relabel the level column from EC to EL for display. Internal compute_ecx
# helpers still return list elements named EC<x> because they consume the
# raw posterior parameter draws; the data tables below feed the UI directly.
ecx_summary$level <- sub("^EC", "EL", ecx_summary$level)
ecx_fert$level    <- sub("^EC", "EL", ecx_fert$level)
ecx_larva$level   <- sub("^EC", "EL", ecx_larva$level)

get_params <- function(ep) if (ep == "fert") params_fert else params_larva
get_ecx    <- function(ep) if (ep == "fert") ecx_fert else ecx_larva
get_psr    <- function(ep) if (ep == "fert") psr_fert else psr_larva

# ============================ #
# 2. UI ####
# ============================ #

seaurchin_theme <- bs_theme(
    version = 5, bootswatch = "cosmo",
    primary   = "#0A6E7C",
    secondary = "#E2B23A",
    base_font = font_collection(font_google("Inter", local = FALSE),
                                "system-ui", "sans-serif"),
    heading_font = font_collection(font_google("Source Serif 4", local = FALSE),
                                   "Georgia", "serif")
)

ui <- page_navbar(
    title = tags$span(
        tags$img(src = "seaurchin_logo.svg", height = "28px",
                 style = "margin-right: 8px; vertical-align: middle;"),
        textOutput("brand_title", inline = TRUE)
    ),
    window_title = "seaurchin",
    theme = seaurchin_theme,
    id    = "main_nav",
    fillable = FALSE,
    header = tagList(
        tags$head(
            tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", type = "text/css",
                      href = "custom.css"),
            tags$script(src = "download.js"),
            tags$script(src = "clipboard.js"),
            tags$script(src = "mathjax-config.js"),
            tags$script(async = NA,
                        src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/tex-mml-chtml.js")
        )
    ),

    # ---------- welcome ----------
    nav_panel(
        title = textOutput("nav_welcome", inline = TRUE),
        value = "welcome",
        div(class = "hero-banner",
            h1(textOutput("hero_h1", inline = TRUE)),
            p(class = "tagline", textOutput("hero_tagline", inline = TRUE)),
            p(textOutput("welcome_intro", inline = TRUE)),
            actionButton("go_predict", label = NULL, class = "btn btn-primary",
                         icon = icon("arrow-right"))
        ),
        layout_columns(
            col_widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
            value_box(title = textOutput("vb_vials_lbl", inline = TRUE),
                      value = "240"),
            value_box(title = textOutput("vb_eggs_lbl", inline = TRUE),
                      value = "≈ 96000"),
            value_box(title = textOutput("vb_endpoints_lbl", inline = TRUE),
                      value = "2"),
            value_box(title = textOutput("vb_model_lbl", inline = TRUE),
                      value = "brms")
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("welcome_sites_h", inline = TRUE)),
            leafletOutput("site_map", height = "360px")
        )
    ),

    # ---------- predict ----------
    nav_panel(
        title = textOutput("nav_predict", inline = TRUE),
        value = "predict",
        layout_sidebar(
            sidebar = sidebar(
                width = 330,
                h5(textOutput("predict_sidebar_h", inline = TRUE)),
                radioButtons("population", label = textOutput("input_population", inline = TRUE),
                             choices = c("Malaga", "Cadiz"), selected = "Malaga",
                             inline = TRUE),
                radioButtons("sunscreen",  label = textOutput("input_sunscreen", inline = TRUE),
                             choices = c("C", "E1", "E2"), selected = "C",
                             inline = TRUE),
                radioButtons("endpoint",   label = textOutput("input_endpoint", inline = TRUE),
                             choices = c("fert", "larva"), selected = "larva",
                             inline = TRUE),
                uiOutput("ui_endpoint_lbls"),
                textAreaInput("conc_text",
                              label = textOutput("input_conc", inline = TRUE),
                              value = "1, 5, 10, 50",
                              placeholder = "1, 5, 10, 50", rows = 2),
                uiOutput("ui_conc_help"),
                hr(),
                sliderInput("n_draws_show", label = textOutput("input_n_draws", inline = TRUE),
                            min = 0, max = 1000, value = 200, step = 50),
                sliderInput("ci_level", label = textOutput("input_ci_level", inline = TRUE),
                            min = 0.5, max = 0.99, value = 0.95, step = 0.01),
                numericInput("threshold_pct",
                             label = textOutput("input_threshold", inline = TRUE),
                             value = 20, min = 1, max = 99, step = 1),
                checkboxInput("log_x", label = textOutput("input_log_x", inline = TRUE),
                              value = TRUE)
            ),
            layout_columns(
                col_widths = c(4, 4, 4),
                value_box(title = textOutput("vb_ec50_lbl", inline = TRUE),
                          value = textOutput("vb_ec50_val", inline = TRUE)),
                value_box(title = textOutput("vb_pred_lbl", inline = TRUE),
                          value = textOutput("vb_pred_val", inline = TRUE)),
                value_box(title = textOutput("vb_pthr_lbl", inline = TRUE),
                          value = textOutput("vb_pthr_val", inline = TRUE))
            ),
            card(
                card_header(div(class = "d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center",
                                textOutput("card_dr_title", inline = TRUE),
                                actionButton("download_dr_png", label = NULL,
                                             icon = icon("download"),
                                             class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"))),
                plotOutput("dr_plot", height = "440px")
            ),
            layout_columns(
                col_widths = c(6, 6),
                card(
                    card_header(textOutput("card_density_title", inline = TRUE)),
                    plotOutput("density_plot", height = "300px")
                ),
                card(
                    card_header(textOutput("card_hypo_title", inline = TRUE)),
                    plotlyOutput("hypo_plot", height = "300px")
                )
            ),
            card(
                card_header(div(class = "d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center",
                                textOutput("card_table_title", inline = TRUE),
                                actionButton("download_pred_csv", label = NULL,
                                             icon = icon("download"),
                                             class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"))),
                DTOutput("pred_table")
            ),
            card(
                class = "citation-card",
                htmlOutput("citation_sentence"),
                actionButton("copy_citation", label = NULL,
                             icon = icon("copy"),
                             class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm mt-2")
            ),
            card(
                card_header(textOutput("whatif_h", inline = TRUE)),
                uiOutput("whatif_help_ui"),
                layout_columns(
                    col_widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
                    sliderInput("shift_pminLo", label = textOutput("whatif_pmin", inline = TRUE),
                                min = -1.5, max = 1.5, value = 0, step = 0.05),
                    sliderInput("shift_pmaxLo", label = textOutput("whatif_pmax", inline = TRUE),
                                min = -1.5, max = 1.5, value = 0, step = 0.05),
                    sliderInput("shift_lEC", label = textOutput("whatif_lEL", inline = TRUE),
                                min = -1.5, max = 1.5, value = 0, step = 0.05),
                    sliderInput("shift_b", label = textOutput("whatif_b", inline = TRUE),
                                min = -0.6, max = 0.6, value = 0, step = 0.05)
                ),
                actionButton("whatif_reset", label = NULL, icon = icon("undo"),
                             class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm")
            )
        )
    ),

    # ---------- PSR ----------
    nav_panel(
        title = textOutput("nav_psr", inline = TRUE),
        value = "psr",
        h4(textOutput("psr_h", inline = TRUE)),
        layout_columns(
            col_widths = c(7, 5),
            card(
                card_header(textOutput("psr_density_title", inline = TRUE)),
                plotOutput("psr_density_plot", height = "360px")
            ),
            card(
                card_header(textOutput("psr_forest_title", inline = TRUE)),
                plotOutput("psr_forest_plot", height = "360px")
            )
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("psr_tile_title", inline = TRUE)),
            plotOutput("psr_tile_plot", height = "260px")
        )
    ),

    # ---------- sunscreen ----------
    nav_panel(
        title = textOutput("nav_sunscreen", inline = TRUE),
        value = "sunscreen",
        h4(textOutput("sunscreen_h", inline = TRUE)),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("sunscreen_panels_title", inline = TRUE)),
            plotOutput("sunscreen_panels_plot", height = "380px")
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("sunscreen_diff_title", inline = TRUE)),
            radioButtons("sunscreen_diff_pop", label = NULL,
                         choices = c("Malaga", "Cadiz"), selected = "Malaga",
                         inline = TRUE),
            plotOutput("sunscreen_diff_plot", height = "320px")
        )
    ),

    # ---------- EC reference ----------
    nav_panel(
        title = textOutput("nav_ec", inline = TRUE),
        value = "ec",
        uiOutput("ec_help_ui"),
        checkboxGroupInput("ec_levels_show",
                           label = textOutput("input_ec_levels", inline = TRUE),
                           choices = c("EL5", "EL10", "EL20", "EL50"),
                           selected = c("EL5", "EL10", "EL20", "EL50"),
                           inline = TRUE),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("ec_forest_title", inline = TRUE)),
            plotOutput("ec_forest_plot", height = "440px")
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("ec_table_title", inline = TRUE)),
            DTOutput("ec_table")
        )
    ),

    # ---------- raw data ----------
    nav_panel(
        title = textOutput("nav_data", inline = TRUE),
        value = "data",
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("data_scatter_title", inline = TRUE)),
            uiOutput("shrink_help_ui"),
            sliderInput("shrink_n", label = textOutput("shrink_n_lbl", inline = TRUE),
                        min = 0, max = 16, value = 0, step = 1),
            plotOutput("raw_scatter_plot", height = "420px")
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("data_table_title", inline = TRUE)),
            DTOutput("raw_table")
        )
    ),

    # ---------- methods ----------
    nav_panel(
        title = textOutput("nav_methods", inline = TRUE),
        value = "methods",
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("methods_h", inline = TRUE)),
            div(class = "theory-content tex2jax_process",
                uiOutput("methods_body_ui"))
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("methods_params_title", inline = TRUE)),
            plotOutput("methods_params_plot", height = "320px")
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("methods_ppc_title", inline = TRUE)),
            plotOutput("methods_ppc_plot", height = "440px")
        )
    ),

    # ---------- about ----------
    nav_panel(
        title = textOutput("nav_about", inline = TRUE),
        value = "about",
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("about_citation_h", inline = TRUE)),
            uiOutput("about_citation_body_ui"),
            actionButton("copy_about_citation", label = NULL, icon = icon("copy"),
                         class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm mt-2")
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("about_contrib_h", inline = TRUE)),
            uiOutput("about_contrib_body_ui")
        ),
        card(
            card_header(textOutput("about_licence_h", inline = TRUE)),
            uiOutput("about_licence_body_ui")
        )
    ),

    nav_spacer(),
    nav_item(
        actionButton("lang_toggle", label = "ES",
                     class = "btn btn-outline-light btn-sm",
                     style = "margin: 6px 4px 0 0;")
    ),
    nav_item(input_dark_mode(id = "dark_mode"))
)

# ============================ #
# 3. server ####
# ============================ #

server <- function(input, output, session) {

    lang <- reactiveVal("en")

    observeEvent(input$lang_toggle, {
        lang(if (lang() == "en") "es" else "en")
        updateActionButton(session, "lang_toggle",
                           label = t_("lang_btn", lang()))
    })

    observeEvent(input$go_predict, {
        bslib::nav_select(id = "main_nav", selected = "predict")
    })

    # ---------- shared reactive values ----------

    user_concs <- reactive({
        v <- parse_concentrations(input$conc_text)
        v[v > 0]   # control (0) handled separately by the model
    })

    active_params <- reactive({
        get_params(input$endpoint)
    })

    active_cell <- reactive({
        filter_cell(active_params(), input$population, input$sunscreen)
    })

    perturbed_cell <- reactive({
        shifts <- c(pminLo = input$shift_pminLo, pmaxLo = input$shift_pmaxLo,
                    lEC    = input$shift_lEC,    b      = input$shift_b)
        if (all(shifts == 0)) return(active_cell())
        perturb_draws(active_cell(), shift = shifts)
    })

    observeEvent(input$whatif_reset, {
        updateSliderInput(session, "shift_pminLo", value = 0)
        updateSliderInput(session, "shift_pmaxLo", value = 0)
        updateSliderInput(session, "shift_lEC",    value = 0)
        updateSliderInput(session, "shift_b",      value = 0)
    })

    user_pred <- reactive({
        v <- user_concs()
        if (length(v) == 0L) return(NULL)
        predict_at_conc(perturbed_cell(), v, ci_level = input$ci_level,
                        threshold_pct = input$threshold_pct)
    })

    active_ec50_median <- reactive({
        ecx <- compute_ecx_draws(perturbed_cell(), x_levels = 0.50)$EC50
        stats::median(ecx, na.rm = TRUE)
    })

    # ---------- branding and nav titles ----------

    output$brand_title  <- renderText({ t_("app_title", lang()) })
    output$nav_welcome  <- renderText({ t_("nav_welcome", lang()) })
    output$nav_predict  <- renderText({ t_("nav_predict", lang()) })
    output$nav_psr      <- renderText({ t_("nav_psr", lang()) })
    output$nav_sunscreen<- renderText({ t_("nav_sunscreen", lang()) })
    output$nav_ec       <- renderText({ t_("nav_ec", lang()) })
    output$nav_data     <- renderText({ t_("nav_data", lang()) })
    output$nav_methods  <- renderText({ t_("nav_methods", lang()) })
    output$nav_about    <- renderText({ t_("nav_about", lang()) })

    # ---------- welcome ----------

    output$hero_h1        <- renderText({ t_("welcome_h1", lang()) })
    output$hero_tagline   <- renderText({ t_("app_tagline", lang()) })
    output$welcome_intro  <- renderText({ t_("welcome_intro", lang()) })
    output$vb_vials_lbl   <- renderText({ t_("welcome_box_vials", lang()) })
    output$vb_eggs_lbl    <- renderText({ t_("welcome_box_eggs", lang()) })
    output$vb_endpoints_lbl <- renderText({ t_("welcome_box_endpoints", lang()) })
    output$vb_model_lbl   <- renderText({ t_("welcome_box_model", lang()) })
    output$welcome_sites_h <- renderText({ t_("welcome_sites_h", lang()) })
    output$site_map <- renderLeaflet({ build_sites_map(site_meta, lang()) })

    # ---------- predict tab labels ----------

    output$predict_sidebar_h <- renderText({ t_("predict_sidebar_h", lang()) })
    output$input_population  <- renderText({ t_("input_population", lang()) })
    output$input_sunscreen   <- renderText({ t_("input_sunscreen", lang()) })
    output$input_endpoint    <- renderText({ t_("input_endpoint", lang()) })
    output$input_conc        <- renderText({ t_("input_conc", lang()) })
    output$input_n_draws     <- renderText({ t_("input_n_draws", lang()) })
    output$input_ci_level    <- renderText({ t_("input_ci_level", lang()) })
    output$input_threshold   <- renderText({ t_("input_threshold", lang()) })
    output$input_log_x       <- renderText({ t_("input_log_x", lang()) })
    output$ui_endpoint_lbls  <- renderUI({
        tags$small(
            sprintf("%s = %s · %s = %s",
                    "fert", t_("input_endpoint_fert", lang()),
                    "larva", t_("input_endpoint_larva", lang())),
            class = "text-muted d-block mb-2"
        )
    })
    output$ui_conc_help      <- renderUI({
        tags$small(t_("input_conc_help", lang()), class = "text-muted")
    })
    output$whatif_h          <- renderText({ t_("whatif_h", lang()) })
    output$whatif_pmin       <- renderText({ t_("whatif_pmin", lang()) })
    output$whatif_pmax       <- renderText({ t_("whatif_pmax", lang()) })
    output$whatif_lEL        <- renderText({ t_("whatif_lEL", lang()) })
    output$whatif_b          <- renderText({ t_("whatif_b", lang()) })
    output$whatif_help_ui    <- renderUI({
        tags$p(t_("whatif_help", lang()), class = "text-muted small")
    })

    output$vb_ec50_lbl <- renderText({ t_("predict_value_ec50", lang()) })
    output$vb_pred_lbl <- renderText({ t_("predict_value_pred", lang()) })
    output$vb_pthr_lbl <- renderText({ t_("predict_value_pthr", lang()) })

    output$vb_ec50_val <- renderText({
        e <- active_ec50_median()
        if (is.na(e) || is.infinite(e)) return("—")
        formatC(e, format = "g", digits = 3)
    })

    output$vb_pred_val <- renderText({
        up <- user_pred()
        if (is.null(up) || nrow(up) == 0L) return("—")
        fmt_pct(stats::median(up$median, na.rm = TRUE))
    })

    output$vb_pthr_val <- renderText({
        up <- user_pred()
        if (is.null(up) || nrow(up) == 0L) return("—")
        sprintf("%.2f", stats::median(up$p_threshold, na.rm = TRUE))
    })

    output$card_dr_title       <- renderText({ t_("predict_plot_card", lang()) })
    output$card_density_title  <- renderText({ t_("predict_density_card", lang()) })
    output$card_hypo_title     <- renderText({ t_("predict_hypo_card", lang()) })
    output$card_table_title    <- renderText({ t_("predict_table_card", lang()) })

    # ---------- F1 ----------

    dr_plot_react <- reactive({
        ghost <- NULL
        if (any(c(input$shift_pminLo, input$shift_pmaxLo,
                  input$shift_lEC, input$shift_b) != 0)) {
            base_curve <- posterior_curve(active_cell(),
                                          seq(-3.2, 2.9, length.out = 220),
                                          ci_level = input$ci_level)
            ghost <- base_curve
        }
        plot_dose_response(
            params_draws = active_params(),
            pred_grid_fallback = NULL,
            population = input$population,
            sunscreen  = input$sunscreen,
            user_conc  = user_concs(),
            ci_level   = input$ci_level,
            n_draws_show = input$n_draws_show,
            log_x = input$log_x,
            lang  = lang(),
            ghost = ghost
        )
    })
    output$dr_plot <- renderPlot({ dr_plot_react() }, res = 100)

    # ---------- F2 ----------

    output$density_plot <- renderPlot({
        v <- user_concs()
        validate(need(length(v) > 0L, t_("warn_no_conc", lang())))
        plot_effect_density(perturbed_cell()[, , drop = FALSE] |>
                              (\(d) { d$population <- input$population;
                                      d$sunscreen <- input$sunscreen; d })() ,
                            input$population, input$sunscreen,
                            v, input$threshold_pct, lang())
    }, res = 100)

    # ---------- F7 ----------

    output$hypo_plot <- renderPlotly({
        v <- user_concs()
        if (length(v) == 0L) return(plotly_empty())
        p <- plot_hypothesis_bars(perturbed_cell() |>
                                    (\(d) { d$population <- input$population;
                                            d$sunscreen <- input$sunscreen; d })() ,
                                  input$population, input$sunscreen, v, lang())
        ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("y"))
    })

    # ---------- predictions table ----------

    pred_table_react <- reactive({
        up <- user_pred()
        if (is.null(up) || nrow(up) == 0L) return(NULL)
        data.frame(
            `Concentration (mg/L)` = up$concentration_mg_L,
            `Median p`              = fmt_pct(up$median),
            `95% CrI`               = fmt_ci(up$lower, up$upper, digits = 1, scale = "pct"),
            `P(effect > threshold)` = sprintf("%.2f", up$p_threshold),
            check.names = FALSE,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    })
    output$pred_table <- renderDT({
        req(pred_table_react())
        datatable(pred_table_react(),
                  options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = FALSE,
                                 columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-right",
                                                        targets = "_all"))),
                  rownames = FALSE, escape = FALSE)
    })

    # ---------- citation sentence + clipboard ----------

    citation_text <- reactive({
        up <- user_pred()
        if (is.null(up) || nrow(up) == 0L) return("")
        first <- up[1, ]
        citable_sentence(conc = first$concentration_mg_L,
                         sunscreen = input$sunscreen,
                         population = input$population,
                         endpoint = input$endpoint,
                         pred_median = first$median,
                         ci_lo = first$lower, ci_hi = first$upper,
                         p_threshold = first$p_threshold,
                         threshold_pct = input$threshold_pct,
                         lang = lang())
    })

    output$citation_sentence <- renderUI({
        txt <- citation_text()
        if (!nzchar(txt)) return(tags$em(t_("warn_no_conc", lang())))
        tags$blockquote(txt)
    })

    observeEvent(input$copy_citation, {
        copy_clipboard(session, citation_text(),
                       button_id = "copy_citation",
                       ack = t_("predict_copy_ack", lang()))
    })

    observeEvent(input$copy_about_citation, {
        copy_clipboard(session, t_("about_citation_body", lang()),
                       button_id = "copy_about_citation",
                       ack = t_("predict_copy_ack", lang()))
    })

    # ---------- PSR tab ----------

    output$psr_h               <- renderText({ t_("psr_h", lang()) })
    output$psr_density_title   <- renderText({ t_("psr_density_card", lang()) })
    output$psr_forest_title    <- renderText({ t_("psr_forest_card", lang()) })
    output$psr_tile_title      <- renderText({ t_("psr_tile_card", lang()) })

    output$psr_density_plot <- renderPlot({
        plot_psr_density(get_psr(input$endpoint), lang = lang())
    }, res = 100)

    output$psr_forest_plot <- renderPlot({
        plot_ec50_caterpillar(ecx_summary,
                              endpoint_keep = if (input$endpoint == "fert")
                                  "fertilisation" else "larva",
                              level_keep = "EL50", lang = lang())
    }, res = 100)

    output$psr_tile_plot <- renderPlot({
        plot_psr_tile(psr_summary, lang = lang())
    }, res = 100)

    # ---------- sunscreen tab ----------

    output$sunscreen_h             <- renderText({ t_("sunscreen_h", lang()) })
    output$sunscreen_panels_title  <- renderText({ t_("sunscreen_panels_card", lang()) })
    output$sunscreen_diff_title    <- renderText({ t_("sunscreen_diff_card", lang()) })

    output$sunscreen_panels_plot <- renderPlot({
        plot_dr_three_panel(active_params(), ci_level = input$ci_level,

                 lang = lang())

# R/download.R
# Server-side handlers that pack a ggplot or a data.frame and ship it to the
# www/download.js shim via Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler. These are required
# for the Shinylive runtime, which has no downloadHandler equivalent.

send_png <- function(session, plot_obj, filename, width = 9, height = 6,
                     dpi = 200) {
    if (is.null(plot_obj)) return(invisible(NULL))
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename = tmp, plot = plot_obj,
                    width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi,
                    units = "in", bg = "white")
    bytes <- readBin(tmp, what = "raw", n = file.info(tmp)$size)
    encoded <- base64enc::base64encode(bytes)
    session$sendCustomMessage("download_png",
                              list(content = encoded, filename = filename))
}

send_csv <- function(session, df, filename) {
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0L) return(invisible(NULL))
    txt <- paste(capture.output(
        utils::write.csv(df, row.names = FALSE)
    ), collapse = "\n")
    session$sendCustomMessage("download_csv",
                              list(content = txt, filename = filename))
}

copy_clipboard <- function(session, text, button_id = NULL,
                           ack = "Copied") {
    session$sendCustomMessage("copy_to_clipboard",
                              list(text = text,
                                   button_id = button_id,
                                   ack = ack))
}

# t_(key, lang): resolves a translation key, falling back to English if the key
# is missing in the target language. lang is "en" or "es".
t_ <- function(key, lang = "en") {
    lang <- match.arg(lang, choices = c("en", "es"))
    v <- i18n_dict[[lang]][[key]]
    if (is.null(v)) v <- i18n_dict[["en"]][[key]]
    if (is.null(v)) v <- key
    v
}

Tile provider is OpenStreetMap; works in the Shinylive # bundle without an API key. build_sites_map <- function(site_meta, lang = "en") { pal <- seaurchin_palette() m <- leaflet::leaflet(site_meta, options = leaflet::leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE, attributionControl = TRUE)) |> leaflet::addTiles() |> leaflet::setView(lng = -5.4, lat = 36.5, zoom = 8) for (i in seq_len(nrow(site_meta))) { pop <- site_meta$population[i] col <- pal$population[[pop]] popup <- paste0( "", site_meta$site_label[i], "

            accent    = "#1F6FB5",
            deep      = "#063743",
            foam      = "#F7FAFB"
        )
    )
}

theme_seaurchin <- function(base_size = 12, base_family = "") {
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
        ggplot2::theme(
            panel.grid.minor   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major   = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.2,
                                                      colour = "grey90"),
            strip.background   = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#ECF3F5",
                                                       colour = NA),
            strip.text         = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size,
                                                       face = "bold",
                                                       colour = "#063743"),
            plot.title         = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 1,
                                                       face = "bold",
                                                       colour = "#063743"),
            plot.subtitle      = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size - 1,
                                                       colour = "grey25"),
            plot.caption       = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size - 2,
                                                       colour = "grey40",
                                                       hjust = 0,
                                                       margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 6)),
            axis.title         = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#063743"),
            axis.text          = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#1f3a3f"),
            legend.position    = "top",
            legend.box.spacing = ggplot2::unit(2, "pt"),
            legend.title       = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
        )
}

# Pretty population labels using site_meta-derived shortcuts; longer site
# labels are reserved for the leaflet popups on the welcome panel.
population_label <- function(p) {
    c(Malaga = "P1: Málaga", Cadiz = "P2: Cádiz")[p]
}

sunscreen_label <- function(s) {
    c(C  = "C: conventional",
      E1 = "E1: milk (new generation)",
      E2 = "E2: oil (new generation)")[s]
}

# Log-10 axis breaks at canonical concentration grid points; suppress the
# control point because it is plotted separately as a reference rectangle.
canonical_log_breaks <- function() {
    c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 500)
}

name: R/plots.R
content:
# R/plots.R
# Figure builders for the prediction tab and the methods tab.
# F1 dose-response with posterior ribbon and spaghetti
# F2 posterior density of predicted effect at the user dose
# F7 hypothesis posterior bar
# F11 per-cell posterior intervals
# F12 posterior predictive check (cell-aggregated)

# ---------- F1 ----------

plot_dose_response <- function(params_draws, pred_grid_fallback,
                               population, sunscreen,
                               user_conc = numeric(0),
                               ci_level = 0.95,
                               n_draws_show = 300L,
                               log_x = TRUE,
                               lang = "en",
                               ghost = NULL) {
    pal <- seaurchin_palette()
    cell <- filter_cell(params_draws, population, sunscreen)
    log10c_grid <- seq(-3.2, 2.9, length.out = 220)
    curve <- posterior_curve(cell, log10c_grid, ci_level = ci_level)
    spag  <- posterior_spaghetti(cell, log10c_grid, n_show = n_draws_show)
    pop_col <- pal$population[[population]]
    sub <- sprintf("posterior 4PL on %s in %s, %d%% credible band",
                   sunscreen, population_label(population),
                   as.integer(round(100 * ci_level)))
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot()
    if (!is.null(ghost)) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
            data = ghost,
            ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L,
                         ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
            fill = "grey75", alpha = 0.25, inherit.aes = FALSE
        )
    }
    p <- p +
        ggplot2::geom_line(data = spag,
                           ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = p,
                                        group = draw),
                           colour = pop_col, alpha = 0.04, linewidth = 0.3) +
        ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = curve,
                             ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L,
                                          ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                             fill = pop_col, alpha = 0.22) +
        ggplot2::geom_line(data = curve,
                           ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = median),
                           colour = pop_col, linewidth = 0.9)
    if (length(user_conc) > 0L) {
        user_pred <- predict_at_conc(cell, user_conc, ci_level = ci_level)
        p <- p +
            ggplot2::geom_segment(data = user_pred,
                ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L, xend = concentration_mg_L,
                             y = lower, yend = upper),
                colour = pal$brand$secondary, linewidth = 0.8) +
            ggplot2::geom_point(data = user_pred,
                ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = median),
                shape = 23, size = 3.6,
                fill = pal$brand$secondary, colour = pal$brand$deep, stroke = 0.6)
    }
    p <- p +
        ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                                    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
        ggplot2::labs(
            x = t_(if (log_x) "xlab_log_conc" else "xlab_conc", lang),
            y = t_("ylab_prop", lang),
            subtitle = sub,
            caption = t_("caption_draws", lang)
        ) +
        theme_seaurchin()
    if (log_x) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::scale_x_log10(
            breaks = canonical_log_breaks(),
            limits = c(0.001, 1000),
            labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE)
        )
    }
    p
}

# ---------- F2 ----------

plot_effect_density <- function(params_draws, population, sunscreen,
                                conc_mg_L, threshold_pct = 20, lang = "en") {
    if (length(conc_mg_L) == 0L) return(NULL)
    pal <- seaurchin_palette()
    cell <- filter_cell(params_draws, population, sunscreen)
    lc <- log10(pmax(conc_mg_L, 0) + LOG_OFFSET_MG_L)
    mat <- eval_4pl(cell, lc)
    pmax_draws <- plogis(cell$pmaxLo)
    # effect = 1 - p / pmax per draw; stack into long
    rows <- lapply(seq_along(conc_mg_L), function(j) {
        eff <- 1 - mat[, j] / pmax_draws
        data.frame(conc = conc_mg_L[j], effect = eff)
    })
    d <- do.call(rbind, rows)
    d$facet <- factor(sprintf("%.3g mg/L", d$conc),
                      levels = unique(sprintf("%.3g mg/L", conc_mg_L)))
    thr <- threshold_pct / 100
    sub <- sprintf("effect = 1 - p / pmax per draw, threshold at %d%%",
                   as.integer(threshold_pct))
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = effect)) +
        ggplot2::geom_density(fill = pal$population[[population]],
                              colour = pal$brand$deep, alpha = 0.55) +
        ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = thr,
                            colour = pal$brand$secondary,
                            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ facet, scales = "free_y") +
        ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                                    limits = c(min(0, min(d$effect)), 1)) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = "Effect (1 - p/pmax)", y = t_("ylab_density", lang),
                      subtitle = sub,
                      caption = t_("caption_draws", lang)) +
        theme_seaurchin()
    p
}

# ---------- F7 ----------

plot_hypothesis_bars <- function(params_draws, population, sunscreen,
                                 conc_mg_L, lang = "en") {
    if (length(conc_mg_L) == 0L) return(NULL)
    pal <- seaurchin_palette()
    cell <- filter_cell(params_draws, population, sunscreen)
    lc <- log10(pmax(conc_mg_L, 0) + LOG_OFFSET_MG_L)
    mat <- eval_4pl(cell, lc)
    pmax_draws <- plogis(cell$pmaxLo)
    thresholds <- c(0.20, 0.50, 0.80)
    rows <- list()
    for (j in seq_along(conc_mg_L)) {
        eff <- 1 - mat[, j] / pmax_draws
        for (thr in thresholds) {
            rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
                conc = conc_mg_L[j],
                threshold = sprintf("> %d%%", as.integer(100 * thr)),
                prob = mean(eff > thr, na.rm = TRUE)
            )
        }
    }
    d <- do.call(rbind, rows)
    d$conc_lbl <- factor(sprintf("%.3g mg/L", d$conc),
                         levels = unique(sprintf("%.3g mg/L", conc_mg_L)))
    sub <- sprintf("posterior probability of exceeding each effect threshold")
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = threshold, y = prob,
                                         fill = conc_lbl)) +
        ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.85),
                          width = 0.78, colour = pal$brand$deep,
                          linewidth = 0.25) +
        ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", prob)),
                           position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.85),
                           vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2, colour = pal$brand$deep) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05),
                                    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = scales::seq_gradient_pal(
            low = "#9CCCD3", high = pal$brand$primary)(
            seq(0, 1, length.out = length(conc_mg_L)))) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = "Effect threshold",
                      y = t_("ylab_prob", lang),
                      fill = "Concentration",
                      subtitle = sub,
                      caption = t_("caption_draws", lang)) +
        theme_seaurchin()
    p
}

# ---------- F11 ----------

plot_param_intervals <- function(params_draws, lang = "en") {
    pal <- seaurchin_palette()
    long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(params_draws,
        cols = c("pminLo", "pmaxLo", "lEC", "b"),
        names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value")
    summ <- dplyr::summarise(
        dplyr::group_by(long, population, sunscreen, parameter),
        median = stats::median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower  = stats::quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
        upper  = stats::quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
    summ$cell <- paste(summ$population, summ$sunscreen, sep = " · ")
    parameter_order <- c("pminLo", "pmaxLo", "lEC", "b")
    summ$parameter <- factor(summ$parameter, levels = parameter_order)
    sub <- "median and 95% credible interval of each non-linear parameter per cell"
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(summ,
            ggplot2::aes(x = median, y = cell,
                         xmin = lower, xmax = upper,
                         colour = sunscreen)) +
        ggplot2::geom_errorbar(orientation = "y", width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.4) +
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
        ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal$sunscreen,
                                     name = t_("legend_sunscreen", lang)) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
                      subtitle = sub,
                      caption = t_("caption_draws", lang)) +
        theme_seaurchin()
    p
}

# ---------- F12 ----------

plot_ppc <- function(params_draws, raw_long, endpoint = c("fert", "larva"),
                     lang = "en") {
    endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
    pal <- seaurchin_palette()
    response_col <- if (endpoint == "fert") "fertilisation_pct" else "larval_dev_pct"
    raw <- raw_long
    raw$prop_obs <- raw[[response_col]] / 100
    # Generate one posterior replicate per draw at each observed concentration.
    log10c_grid <- log10(pmax(unique(raw$concentration_mg_L), 0) + LOG_OFFSET_MG_L)
    rows <- list()
    for (p in unique(raw$population)) for (s in unique(raw$sunscreen)) {
        cell <- filter_cell(params_draws, p, s)
        if (nrow(cell) == 0L) next
        mat <- eval_4pl(cell, log10c_grid)
        # sample one replicate per (draw, log10c) by drawing Binomial(100, p)
        # for a true PPC; mean(prop) across draws is the predictive expectation.
        rep_props <- as.numeric(stats::rbinom(length(mat), 100, as.numeric(mat))) / 100
        rep_props <- matrix(rep_props, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat))
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
            population = p, sunscreen = s, source = "replicated",
            prop = as.numeric(rep_props)
        )
    }
    rep_df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
    obs_df <- data.frame(
        population = raw$population, sunscreen = raw$sunscreen,
        source = "observed", prop = raw$prop_obs
    )
    d <- rbind(obs_df, rep_df)
    sub <- sprintf("density of observed proportions vs posterior replicates (%s)",
                   endpoint)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = prop, colour = source,
                                         fill = source)) +
        ggplot2::geom_density(alpha = 0.35) +
        ggplot2::facet_grid(population ~ sunscreen) +
        ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                                    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
        ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(observed = pal$brand$deep,
                                                replicated = pal$brand$accent)) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(observed = pal$brand$deep,
                                              replicated = pal$brand$accent)) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = t_("ylab_prop", lang), y = t_("ylab_density", lang),
                      subtitle = sub,
                      caption = t_("caption_draws", lang)) +
        theme_seaurchin()
    p
}

# ---------- F5 ----------

plot_ec50_caterpillar <- function(ecx_summary, endpoint_keep = NULL,

plot_ec_forest <- function(ecx_summary, levels_keep = c("EL5","EL10","EL20","EL50"),

# ---------- F8 ----------

plot_psr_tile <- function(psr_summary, lang = "en") {

# R/plots_raw.R
# F10 vial-level scatter with overlaid posterior median curve and (optionally)
#     a shrunken credible band illustrating the posterior-shrinkage demo.

plot_raw_scatter <- function(raw_long, params_draws, population, sunscreen,
                             endpoint = c("fert", "larva"),
                             shrink_n = NULL, ci_level = 0.95,
                             log_x = TRUE, lang = "en") {
    endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
    response_col <- if (endpoint == "fert") "fertilisation_pct" else "larval_dev_pct"
    pal <- seaurchin_palette()
    raw <- raw_long[raw_long$population == population &
                    raw_long$sunscreen  == sunscreen, , drop = FALSE]
    raw$prop_obs <- raw[[response_col]] / 100
    cell <- filter_cell(params_draws, population, sunscreen)
    log10c_grid <- seq(-3.2, 2.9, length.out = 200)
    curve <- posterior_curve(cell, log10c_grid, ci_level = ci_level)
    shrink_curve <- NULL
    if (!is.null(shrink_n) && is.numeric(shrink_n) && shrink_n > 0L) {
        set.seed(20260519)
        shrunk <- shrink_draws(cell, n_eff = as.integer(shrink_n))
        shrink_curve <- posterior_curve(shrunk, log10c_grid, ci_level = ci_level)
    }
    pop_col <- pal$population[[population]]
    sub <- sprintf("vial-level proportions vs posterior median in %s with sunscreen %s",
                   population_label(population), sunscreen)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot()
    if (!is.null(shrink_curve)) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = shrink_curve,
            ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
            fill = pal$brand$secondary, alpha = 0.18)
    }
    p <- p +
        ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = curve,
            ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
            fill = pop_col, alpha = 0.22) +
        ggplot2::geom_line(data = curve,
            ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L, y = median),
            colour = pop_col, linewidth = 0.85) +
        ggplot2::geom_jitter(data = raw,
            ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L + LOG_OFFSET_MG_L,
                         y = prop_obs, shape = replicate),
            width = 0.05, height = 0.005, size = 2.1,
            colour = pal$brand$deep, fill = pal$brand$foam, stroke = 0.5) +
        ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(A = 21, B = 22, C = 24, D = 23),
                                    name = "Replicate") +
        ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
            labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = t_(if (log_x) "xlab_log_conc" else "xlab_conc", lang),
                      y = t_("ylab_prop", lang),
                      subtitle = sub,
                      caption = t_("caption_draws", lang)) +
        theme_seaurchin()
    if (log_x) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = canonical_log_breaks(),
                                        limits = c(0.001, 1000),
                                        labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE))
    }
    p
}

# R/plots_sunscreen.R
# F3 three-panel dose-response by sunscreen, both populations overlaid
# F9 EC difference posterior density (E1 - C, E2 - C)

# ---------- F3 ----------

plot_dr_three_panel <- function(params_draws, ci_level = 0.95,
                                log_x = TRUE, lang = "en") {
    pal <- seaurchin_palette()
    log10c_grid <- seq(-3.2, 2.9, length.out = 200)
    rows <- list()
    for (p in c("Malaga", "Cadiz")) for (s in c("C", "E1", "E2")) {
        cell <- filter_cell(params_draws, p, s)
        if (nrow(cell) == 0L) next
        curve <- posterior_curve(cell, log10c_grid, ci_level = ci_level)
        curve$population <- p
        curve$sunscreen  <- s
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- curve
    }
    d <- do.call(rbind, rows)
    sub <- sprintf("posterior median (line) and %d%% credible band (ribbon) per cell",
                   as.integer(round(100 * ci_level)))
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = concentration_mg_L,
                                         y = median,
                                         colour = population, fill = population)) +
        ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                             alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
        ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ sunscreen, nrow = 1,
                            labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(sunscreen_label)) +
        ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal$population,
                                     labels = population_label,
                                     name = t_("legend_population", lang)) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal$population,
                                   labels = population_label,
                                   name = t_("legend_population", lang)) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                                    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = t_(if (log_x) "xlab_log_conc" else "xlab_conc", lang),
                      y = t_("ylab_prop", lang),
                      subtitle = sub,
                      caption = t_("caption_draws", lang)) +
        theme_seaurchin()
    if (log_x) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = canonical_log_breaks(),
                                        limits = c(0.001, 1000),
                                        labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE))
    }
    p
}

# ---------- F9 ----------

plot_ec_diff_density <- function(ecx_draws, level = "EL50",
                                 population_keep = "Malaga", lang = "en") {
    pal <- seaurchin_palette()
    d <- ecx_draws[ecx_draws$level == level &
                   ecx_draws$population == population_keep, , drop = FALSE]
    wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(d, id_cols = "draw",
                               names_from = "sunscreen",
                               values_from = "ecx_mg_L")
    log10 <- function(x) base::log10(pmax(x, 1e-9))
    diff_df <- rbind(
        data.frame(contrast = "E1 - C", value = log10(wide$E1) - log10(wide$C)),
        data.frame(contrast = "E2 - C", value = log10(wide$E2) - log10(wide$C))
    )
    diff_df <- diff_df[stats::complete.cases(diff_df), , drop = FALSE]
    sub <- sprintf("posterior of log10 %s difference vs sunscreen C in %s",
                   level, population_label(population_keep))
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(diff_df, ggplot2::aes(x = value, fill = contrast,
                                               colour = contrast)) +
        ggplot2::geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
        ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                            colour = pal$brand$deep, linewidth = 0.5) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("E1 - C" = pal$sunscreen[["E1"]],
                                              "E2 - C" = pal$sunscreen[["E2"]])) +
        ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c("E1 - C" = pal$sunscreen[["E1"]],
                                                "E2 - C" = pal$sunscreen[["E2"]])) +
        ggplot2::labs(x = t_("sunscreen_diff_label", lang),
                      y = t_("ylab_density", lang),
                      fill = NULL, colour = NULL,
                      subtitle = sub,
                      caption = t_("caption_draws", lang)) +
        theme_seaurchin()
    p
}

name: R/posterior.R
content:
# R/posterior.R
# Pure-R posterior layer. Loads the parameter draws once at app startup,
# evaluates the 4PL forward and inverse on demand, and computes quantiles
# and tail probabilities from draw arrays. No brms, no Stan; everything
# runs in the Shinylive WebAssembly runtime.

# Offset applied during the original log-10 transformation to handle the
# control concentration (0 mg/L). Matches log_offset_mg_L() in the parent
# project's R/utils.R.
LOG_OFFSET_MG_L <- 1e-3

# ---------- loaders ----------

load_params_draws <- function(endpoint = c("fert", "larva")) {
    endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
    read_csv_gz(file.path("data", paste0("params_draws_", endpoint, ".csv.gz")))
}

load_pred_grid <- function(endpoint = c("fert", "larva")) {
    endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
    read_csv_gz(file.path("data", paste0("pred_grid_", endpoint, ".csv.gz")))
}

load_ecx_draws <- function(endpoint = c("fert", "larva")) {
    endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
    read_csv_gz(file.path("data", paste0("ecx_draws_", endpoint, ".csv.gz")))
}

load_psr_draws <- function(endpoint = c("fert", "larva")) {
    endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
    read_csv_gz(file.path("data", paste0("psr_draws_", endpoint, ".csv.gz")))
}

# ---------- 4PL forward ----------

# eval_4pl: vectorised in both lc and the draw axis. Given a long-format
# parameter draws table filtered to a single (population, sunscreen) cell
# and a vector of log10 concentrations, returns a matrix [n_draws x n_lc]
# of predicted proportions.
eval_4pl <- function(draws_cell, lc) {
    stopifnot(all(c("pminLo", "pmaxLo", "lEC", "b") %in% names(draws_cell)))
    pmin <- plogis(draws_cell$pminLo)
    pmax <- plogis(draws_cell$pmaxLo)
    lEC  <- draws_cell$lEC
    b    <- draws_cell$b
    # outer product trick: each row is a draw, each column an lc value.
    out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(pmin), ncol = length(lc))
    for (j in seq_along(lc)) {
        denom <- 1 + 10^(b * (lc[j] - lEC))
        out[, j] <- pmin + (pmax - pmin) / denom
    }
    out
}

# Convenience: filter draws to one cell. Returns a data.frame in the same
# columns as the input, restricted to the given population:sunscreen.
filter_cell <- function(draws, population, sunscreen) {
    keep <- draws$population == population & draws$sunscreen == sunscreen
    draws[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Apply a what-if perturbation to a draws_cell: add Gaussian noise of the
# specified per-parameter magnitudes (sd interpreted as the user-provided
# shift). The "shift" is a translation; the sd is fixed at 0.05 to soften
# the visual effect. Returns a perturbed draws_cell with the same shape.
perturb_draws <- function(draws_cell, shift = c(pminLo = 0, pmaxLo = 0,
                                                lEC = 0, b = 0)) {
    draws_cell$pminLo <- draws_cell$pminLo + shift["pminLo"]
    draws_cell$pmaxLo <- draws_cell$pmaxLo + shift["pmaxLo"]
    draws_cell$lEC    <- draws_cell$lEC    + shift["lEC"]
    draws_cell$b      <- draws_cell$b      + shift["b"]
    draws_cell
}

# Posterior-shrinkage demo: pretend the study had n_eff vials per cell.
# Resample draw indices with replacement, then add Gaussian jitter scaled
# by 1/sqrt(n_eff) on each parameter's posterior sd. Approximation, not a
# refit; captioned honestly in the UI.
shrink_draws <- function(draws_cell, n_eff = 4L) {
    if (n_eff <= 0L) return(draws_cell)
    nd <- nrow(draws_cell)
    idx <- sample.int(nd, size = nd, replace = TRUE)
    out <- draws_cell[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    scale <- 1 / sqrt(max(n_eff, 1))
    out$pminLo <- out$pminLo + rnorm(nd, 0, scale * stats::sd(out$pminLo))
    out$pmaxLo <- out$pmaxLo + rnorm(nd, 0, scale * stats::sd(out$pmaxLo))
    out$lEC    <- out$lEC    + rnorm(nd, 0, scale * stats::sd(out$lEC))
    out$b      <- out$b      + rnorm(nd, 0, scale * stats::sd(out$b))
    out
}

# ---------- predict at user concentrations ----------

# Returns a data.frame with columns (concentration_mg_L, log10c, median,
# lower, upper, p_threshold) where p_threshold is P(effect > threshold)
# on the proportion scale relative to the per-draw pmax baseline.
predict_at_conc <- function(draws_cell, conc_mg_L,
                            ci_level = 0.95,
                            threshold_pct = 20) {
    if (length(conc_mg_L) == 0L) {
        return(data.frame(
            concentration_mg_L = numeric(0),
            log10c             = numeric(0),
            median             = numeric(0),
            lower              = numeric(0),
            upper              = numeric(0),
            p_threshold        = numeric(0)
        ))
    }
    lc <- log10(pmax(conc_mg_L, 0) + LOG_OFFSET_MG_L)
    pred <- eval_4pl(draws_cell, lc)
    qlo <- (1 - ci_level) / 2
    qhi <- 1 - qlo
    pmax_draws <- plogis(draws_cell$pmaxLo)
    threshold_frac <- threshold_pct / 100
    p_threshold <- apply(pred, 2, function(col) {
        eff <- 1 - col / pmax_draws
        mean(eff > threshold_frac, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
    data.frame(
        concentration_mg_L = conc_mg_L,
        log10c             = lc,
        median             = apply(pred, 2, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower              = apply(pred, 2, stats::quantile, qlo, na.rm = TRUE,
                                   names = FALSE),
        upper              = apply(pred, 2, stats::quantile, qhi, na.rm = TRUE,
                                   names = FALSE),
        p_threshold        = p_threshold
    )
}

# ---------- 4PL inverse: arbitrary EC level posteriors ----------

# Direct port of /Andalividus/R/02_models.R::posterior_ecx body, applied to
# a single (population, sunscreen) draws_cell.
compute_ecx_draws <- function(draws_cell, x_levels = c(0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50)) {
    pmax <- plogis(draws_cell$pmaxLo)
    pmin <- plogis(draws_cell$pminLo)
    lEC  <- draws_cell$lEC
    b    <- draws_cell$b
    out <- list()
    for (x in x_levels) {
        p_target <- pmax * (1 - x)
        ratio    <- (pmax - pmin) / (p_target - pmin) - 1
        ratio[ratio <= 0] <- NA_real_
        log10c <- lEC + log10(ratio) / b
        ecx <- 10^log10c - LOG_OFFSET_MG_L
        out[[sprintf("EC%d", round(x * 100))]] <- ecx
    }
    out
}

# ---------- summaries on draws ----------

posterior_quantiles <- function(v, ci_level = 0.95) {
    qlo <- (1 - ci_level) / 2
    qhi <- 1 - qlo
    list(
        median = stats::median(v, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower  = stats::quantile(v, qlo, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
        upper  = stats::quantile(v, qhi, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
    )
}

tail_prob <- function(v, threshold, side = c("<", ">")) {
    side <- match.arg(side)
    if (side == "<") mean(v < threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    else            mean(v > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Posterior dose-response curve over a smooth log10 grid for one cell, with
# arbitrary credible level. Used by F1 and F3.
posterior_curve <- function(draws_cell, log10c_grid, ci_level = 0.95) {
    mat <- eval_4pl(draws_cell, log10c_grid)
    qlo <- (1 - ci_level) / 2
    qhi <- 1 - qlo
    data.frame(
        log10c = log10c_grid,
        concentration_mg_L = 10^log10c_grid - LOG_OFFSET_MG_L,
        median = apply(mat, 2, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower  = apply(mat, 2, stats::quantile, qlo, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
        upper  = apply(mat, 2, stats::quantile, qhi, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
    )
}

# Spaghetti subset: returns a long data.frame (log10c, concentration, p, draw)
# for n_show draws sampled without replacement from draws_cell, evaluated on
# the same log10c_grid. Used by F1 as a translucent overlay.
posterior_spaghetti <- function(draws_cell, log10c_grid, n_show = 200L) {
    nd <- nrow(draws_cell)
    n_show <- min(n_show, nd)
    idx <- sort(sample.int(nd, size = n_show, replace = FALSE))
    sub <- draws_cell[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    mat <- eval_4pl(sub, log10c_grid)
    rows <- lapply(seq_len(n_show), function(i) {
        data.frame(
            draw   = sub$draw[i],
            log10c = log10c_grid,
            concentration_mg_L = 10^log10c_grid - LOG_OFFSET_MG_L,
            p = as.numeric(mat[i, ])
        )
    })
    do.call(rbind, rows)
}

name: README.md
content:
# seaurchin A Shinylive (WebAssembly) companion to the Andalividus Bayesian dose-response study of three sunscreens on two populations of *Paracentrotus lividus*. The app re-evaluates the published 4-parameter logistic model client-side using precomputed posterior parameter draws, producing fully Bayesian predictions, EC values, hypothesis posteriors and figures with 1000 thinned draws of credible uncertainty. The app is bilingual (English default, Spanish toggle) and runs without a server.
## Local preview ```bash cd /path/to/Andalividus Rscript -e 'shiny::runApp("seaurchin", launch.browser = TRUE)' ``` R 4.4 or newer is required. Packages needed for the local preview: `shiny`, `bslib`, `ggplot2`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`, `scales`, `DT`, `plotly`, `leaflet`, `htmltools`, `base64enc`, `markdown`.
## Regenerate the data layer The `data/` directory is generated offline from the cached brms fits at `cache/fit_fert.rds` and `cache/fit_larva.rds`. To regenerate after a refit: ```bash cd /path/to/Andalividus Rscript seaurchin/data-raw/00_export_seaurchin.R ``` The script extracts posterior draws of the four non-linear parameters per population:sunscreen cell, copies the dose-response grids, the EC posterior draws, the PSR posterior draws, and the raw vial-level data into gzipped CSVs. Total payload is approximately 1.3 MB.
## Build the WebAssembly bundle ```r shinylive::export(appdir = "seaurchin", destdir = "seaurchin/docs", subdir = ".", quiet = FALSE) ``` The bundle is self-contained under `seaurchin/docs/`. For local inspection: ```bash cd seaurchin/docs python -m http.server 8000 # open http://localhost:8000 ``` For GitHub Pages serve from the `docs/` directory on the main branch. A `seaurchin/docs/_config.yml` with `theme: null` disables Jekyll so the Shinylive output is served verbatim.
## Citation DataLab ICMAN (2026). seaurchin: a Shinylive companion to the Andalividus Bayesian dose-response study of sunscreen toxicity on *Paracentrotus lividus*. Author: DataLab ICMAN Dashboard licence CC BY 4.0; source code GPL-3.

name: data-raw/00_export_seaurchin.R
content:
# seaurchin/data-raw/00_export_seaurchin.R
# Offline export of posterior parameter draws and derived quantities from the
# Andalividus brms fits into compact gzipped CSVs that the Shinylive bundle can
# load and re-evaluate client-side. Run once; the produced files in
# seaurchin/data/ are the only artefacts shipped with the deployed app.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(here)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(posterior)
})

# Base R CSV writer that emits a UTF-8, quoted, no-row-name file. Used in
# both gzipped and plain modes to avoid the vroom binary dependency that
# readr brings in.
write_csv_base <- function(x, path) {
    utils::write.csv(x, file = path, row.names = FALSE,
                     quote = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
    invisible(path)
}

write_csv_gz <- function(x, path) {
    stopifnot(grepl("\\.csv$", path))
    gz_path <- paste0(path, ".gz")
    con <- gzfile(gz_path, open = "wt", encoding = "UTF-8")
    on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
    utils::write.csv(x, file = con, row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
    invisible(gz_path)
}

# Light replacement for readr::read_csv for the summary step (uses base
# read.csv which does not depend on vroom).
read_csv_gz <- function(path) {
    con <- gzfile(path, open = "rt", encoding = "UTF-8")
    on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
    utils::read.csv(con, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

andalividus_root <- here::here()
out_dir <- here::here("seaurchin", "data")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

log_offset_mg_L <- function() 1e-3
thin_step       <- 4L   # 4000 post-warmup draws thinned to 1000 for shipping
pops            <- c("Malaga", "Cadiz")
creams          <- c("C", "E1", "E2")

# ============================ #
# 1. parameter draws per endpoint  ####
# ============================ #

extract_params <- function(fit) {
    d <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit)
    rows <- list()
    for (p in pops) for (s in creams) {
        suffix <- paste0("population", p, ":sunscreen", s)
        col_pminLo <- paste0("b_pminLo_", suffix)
        col_pmaxLo <- paste0("b_pmaxLo_", suffix)
        col_lEC    <- paste0("b_lEC_",    suffix)
        col_b      <- paste0("b_b_",      suffix)
        stopifnot(all(c(col_pminLo, col_pmaxLo, col_lEC, col_b) %in% colnames(d)))
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
            draw       = d$`.draw`,
            population = p,
            sunscreen  = s,
            pminLo     = d[[col_pminLo]],
            pmaxLo     = d[[col_pmaxLo]],
            lEC        = d[[col_lEC]],
            b          = d[[col_b]]
        )
    }
    dplyr::bind_rows(rows) |>
        dplyr::filter(draw %% thin_step == 0L) |>
        dplyr::arrange(population, sunscreen, draw)
}

for (endpoint in c("fert", "larva")) {
    fit_path <- file.path(andalividus_root, "cache",
                          paste0("fit_", endpoint, ".rds"))
    cat(sprintf("[params] loading %s\n", basename(fit_path)))
    fit  <- readRDS(fit_path)
    pars <- extract_params(fit)
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("params_draws_", endpoint, ".csv"))
    write_csv_gz(pars, csv_path)
    cat(sprintf("[params] wrote %s (%d rows)\n",
                paste0(basename(csv_path), ".gz"), nrow(pars)))
    rm(fit, pars); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
}

# ============================ #
# 2. pred grid (posterior dose-response on canonical log10 grid) ####
# ============================ #

for (endpoint in c("fert", "larva")) {
    src <- file.path(andalividus_root, "cache",
                     paste0("pred_", endpoint, ".rds"))
    g <- readRDS(src) |>
        dplyr::select(population, sunscreen, log10c, concentration_mg_L,
                      median, lower, upper) |>
        dplyr::mutate(concentration_mg_L = 10^log10c - log_offset_mg_L())
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("pred_grid_", endpoint, ".csv"))
    write_csv_gz(g, csv_path)
    cat(sprintf("[pred] wrote %s (%d rows)\n",
                paste0(basename(csv_path), ".gz"), nrow(g)))
}

# ============================ #
# 3. EC draws (thinned to match params) ####
# ============================ #

for (endpoint in c("fert", "larva")) {
    src <- file.path(andalividus_root, "cache",
                     paste0("ecx_", endpoint, "_draws.rds"))
    e <- readRDS(src) |>
        dplyr::filter(draw %% thin_step == 0L) |>
        dplyr::arrange(population, sunscreen, level, draw)
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("ecx_draws_", endpoint, ".csv"))
    write_csv_gz(e, csv_path)
    cat(sprintf("[ecx] wrote %s (%d rows)\n",
                paste0(basename(csv_path), ".gz"), nrow(e)))
}

# ============================ #
# 4. PSR draws (thinned) ####
# ============================ #

for (endpoint in c("fert", "larva")) {
    src <- file.path(andalividus_root, "cache",
                     paste0("psr_", endpoint, "_draws.rds"))
    p <- readRDS(src) |>
        dplyr::filter(draw %% thin_step == 0L) |>
        dplyr::select(sunscreen, draw, Malaga, Cadiz, psr, log10_psr) |>
        dplyr::arrange(sunscreen, draw)
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("psr_draws_", endpoint, ".csv"))
    write_csv_gz(p, csv_path)
    cat(sprintf("[psr] wrote %s (%d rows)\n",
                paste0(basename(csv_path), ".gz"), nrow(p)))
}

# ============================ #
# 5. precomputed summaries (fast hero/EC rendering) ####
# ============================ #

ecx_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    read_csv_gz(file.path(out_dir, "ecx_draws_fert.csv.gz")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(endpoint = "fertilisation"),
    read_csv_gz(file.path(out_dir, "ecx_draws_larva.csv.gz")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(endpoint = "larva")
) |>
    dplyr::group_by(endpoint, population, sunscreen, level) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        median = median(ecx_mg_L, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower  = stats::quantile(ecx_mg_L, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        upper  = stats::quantile(ecx_mg_L, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
write_csv_base(ecx_summary, file.path(out_dir, "ecx_summary.csv"))
cat(sprintf("[summary] wrote ecx_summary.csv (%d rows)\n", nrow(ecx_summary)))

psr_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    read_csv_gz(file.path(out_dir, "psr_draws_fert.csv.gz")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(endpoint = "fertilisation"),
    read_csv_gz(file.path(out_dir, "psr_draws_larva.csv.gz")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(endpoint = "larva")
) |>
    dplyr::group_by(endpoint, sunscreen) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        psr_median   = median(psr, na.rm = TRUE),
        psr_lower    = stats::quantile(psr, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        psr_upper    = stats::quantile(psr, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        prob_psr_lt_1 = mean(psr < 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
write_csv_base(psr_summary, file.path(out_dir, "psr_summary.csv"))
cat(sprintf("[summary] wrote psr_summary.csv (%d rows)\n", nrow(psr_summary)))

# ============================ #
# 6. raw data and metadata (verbatim copies) ####
# ============================ #

file.copy(file.path(andalividus_root, "data", "ecotox_long.csv"),
          file.path(out_dir, "raw_long.csv"),
          overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(file.path(andalividus_root, "data", "site_meta.csv"),
          file.path(out_dir, "site_meta.csv"),
          overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(file.path(andalividus_root, "data", "sunscreen_meta.csv"),
          file.path(out_dir, "sunscreen_meta.csv"),
          overwrite = TRUE)
cat("[copy] raw_long.csv, site_meta.csv, sunscreen_meta.csv\n")

# ============================ #
# 7. payload audit  ####
# ============================ #

files <- list.files(out_dir, full.names = TRUE)
sizes <- file.info(files)$size
audit <- tibble::tibble(
    file = basename(files),
    size_kB = round(sizes / 1024, 1)
) |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(size_kB))
print(audit)
cat(sprintf("[total] %.1f kB\n", sum(sizes) / 1024))

name: tests/testthat/setup-helpers.R
content:
# tests/testthat/setup-helpers.R
# testthat auto-sources every setup-*.R before the test suite. Binds the
# seaurchin R/ helpers into the global environment so individual test files
# do not need their own source() calls.

# Anchor to seaurchin/ explicitly. here::here() would walk up to the parent
# Andalividus.Rproj and resolve R/ to the wrong directory.
seaurchin_root <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(parent.frame()$ofile %||% "."),
                                          "..", ".."),
                                mustWork = FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(file.path(seaurchin_root, "R"))) {
    # Fallback when sourced without ofile context (e.g. testthat 3.x): walk
    # from the current working directory.
    seaurchin_root <- normalizePath("../..", mustWork = TRUE)
}
for (f in list.files(file.path(seaurchin_root, "R"),
                     pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) {
    sys.source(f, envir = globalenv())
}
options(seaurchin.root = seaurchin_root)

name: tests/testthat/test_eval_4pl.R
content:
# tests/testthat/test_eval_4pl.R
# Regression checks on the client-side 4PL forward and inverse helpers.
# Run from the seaurchin/ directory:
#   Rscript -e 'testthat::test_dir("tests/testthat")'

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(testthat)
    library(dplyr)
})

ROOT     <- getOption("seaurchin.root", normalizePath("../..", mustWork = TRUE))
DATA_DIR <- file.path(ROOT, "data")

test_that("EC50 recovery on the canonical cell Malaga x C x larval development", {
    pars <- read_csv_gz(file.path(DATA_DIR, "params_draws_larva.csv.gz"))
    cell <- pars[pars$population == "Malaga" & pars$sunscreen == "C", ,
                 drop = FALSE]
    ecx <- compute_ecx_draws(cell, x_levels = 0.50)$EC50
    ec50_median <- stats::median(ecx, na.rm = TRUE)
    expect_lt(abs(ec50_median - 8.91), 0.3)
})

test_that("Forward 4PL at EC50 equals (pmin + pmax) / 2 to two decimals", {
    pars <- read_csv_gz(file.path(DATA_DIR, "params_draws_larva.csv.gz"))
    cell <- pars[pars$population == "Malaga" & pars$sunscreen == "C", ,
                 drop = FALSE]
    lEC_med <- stats::median(cell$lEC, na.rm = TRUE)
    pred <- eval_4pl(cell, lEC_med)
    p_med <- stats::median(pred[, 1], na.rm = TRUE)
    pmin_med <- stats::median(plogis(cell$pminLo), na.rm = TRUE)
    pmax_med <- stats::median(plogis(cell$pmaxLo), na.rm = TRUE)
    expect_lt(abs(p_med - (pmin_med + pmax_med) / 2), 0.01)
})

test_that("Posterior tail probabilities are bounded in [0, 1]", {
    psr <- read_csv_gz(file.path(DATA_DIR, "psr_draws_fert.csv.gz"))
    p <- tail_prob(psr$psr, 1, side = "<")
    expect_true(is.numeric(p) && p >= 0 && p <= 1)
})

test_that("parse_concentrations is robust to mixed separators and bad input", {
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations("1, 5, 10, 50"), c(1, 5, 10, 50))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations("1;5;10"), c(1, 5, 10))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations("1 5  10"), c(1, 5, 10))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations("1, -2, foo, 5"), c(1, 5))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations(""), numeric(0))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations(NULL), numeric(0))
})

test_that("Bilingual dictionary has no missing keys across languages", {
    keys_en <- names(i18n_dict$en)
    keys_es <- names(i18n_dict$es)
    missing_in_es <- setdiff(keys_en, keys_es)
    missing_in_en <- setdiff(keys_es, keys_en)
    expect_equal(missing_in_es, character(0))
    expect_equal(missing_in_en, character(0))
})
